unit.title: Development D5 — Hobbies, Sport & Leisure
unit.summary: Leisure vocabulary, the Arabic past tense system, and narrative writing about hobbies, sport and holidays.

lessons.title: Hobbies and Free Time — Vocabulary and Present Habits
lessons.arabic: الهِوَايَاتُ وَوَقْتُ الفَرَاغِ — المُفْرَدَاتُ وَالعَادَاتُ الحَاضِرَةُ
lessons.summary: Name eighteen hobbies with their correct verb collocations, state how often you do them, and express preference with three distinct structures.
objectives: Name at least eighteen hobbies using the correct verb collocation.
Describe how often you do a hobby using مَرَّةً / مَرَّتَيْنِ / ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ with a time period.
Express preference using أُفَضِّلُ … عَلَى، أَسْتَمْتِعُ بِـ … أَكْثَرَ مِنْ، and أَهْوَى … حَقًّا.
Choose the right verb for the right activity instead of translating word by word.
success: I choose يَلْعَبُ، يُمَارِسُ، يَعْزِفُ عَلَى and يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَى correctly for each activity.
I use the dual مَرَّتَيْنِ accurately and follow ثَلَاثَ with the genitive plural مَرَّاتٍ.
I build a preference sentence that names two activities and gives a reason with لِأَنَّ.
I can speak for thirty seconds about one hobby with a collocation, a frequency and a reason.

teach.title: Learn the whole collocation, not the single verb
teach.text: Arabic chooses a different verb for different kinds of activity. يَلْعَبُ goes with ball games, يُمَارِسُ with an activity noun, يَعْزِفُ عَلَى with an instrument and يَسْتَمِعُ إِلَى with sound. Store the verb, the preposition and the noun together as one unit.

teach.title: The syllabus lists many hobbies as verbal nouns
teach.text: The Cambridge list gives السِّبَاحَةُ، الرَّسْمُ، القِرَاءَةُ، الغِنَاءُ، رُكُوبُ الدَّرَّاجَةِ — verbal nouns rather than verbs. Learn both shapes: the verbal noun for lists and headings, the verb for saying what you personally do.

grammar.title: Collocation, frequency and preference
grammar.overview: Three systems carry this lesson: choosing the right verb for the activity, saying how often, and ranking two activities against each other. Study each in context and compare an accurate sentence with a plausible but wrong one.

rules.heading: يَلْعَبُ with ball games
rules.explanation: يَلْعَبُ is used for games played with a ball or a board. The noun that follows is the direct object and therefore accusative.

rules.heading: يُمَارِسُ with an activity noun
rules.explanation: يُمَارِسُ suits a sustained activity or discipline rather than a game. The activity noun that follows is accusative.

rules.heading: يَعْزِفُ عَلَى with an instrument
rules.explanation: The preposition عَلَى is fixed with يَعْزِفُ, and the instrument after it is genitive. The Cambridge list also records the verbal noun form العَزْفُ بِـ, so recognise both.

rules.heading: Frequency after a number
rules.formula: مَرَّةً / مَرَّتَيْنِ / ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ + فِي + period
rules.explanation: مَرَّةً is adverbial and accusative. مَرَّتَيْنِ is the dual. From three to ten the counted noun becomes a genitive plural: ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate football sentence.
options: أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
أُمَارِسُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ مَرَّتَانِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
أَعْزِفُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
quiz.feedback: Ball games take يَلْعَبُ, and the dual after a preposition-free adverbial is مَرَّتَيْنِ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate swimming sentence.
options: أُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
أَلْعَبُ السِّبَاحَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
أُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةُ ثَلَاثُ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
quiz.feedback: السِّبَاحَة is an activity noun, so it takes يُمَارِسُ, and as the object it is accusative.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate instrument sentence.
quiz.feedback: يَعْزِفُ is fixed with عَلَى, and the instrument after it is genitive.

quiz.prompt: Complete: أَسْتَمِعُ ___ المُوسِيقَى العَرَبِيَّةِ.
quiz.feedback: يَسْتَمِعُ takes إِلَى.

quiz.prompt: Which frequency phrase is accurate?
quiz.feedback: مَرَّة is feminine, so the number drops the tāʾ, and 3–10 take the genitive plural مَرَّاتٍ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate preference sentence.
quiz.feedback: أُفَضِّلُ takes an accusative object, and the less-preferred thing follows عَلَى in the genitive.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate enjoyment sentence.
quiz.feedback: أَسْتَمْتِعُ requires بِـ, and a noun after a preposition is genitive.

quiz.prompt: Choose the sentence that adds a reason accurately.
options: أَهْوَى تَسَلُّقَ الجِبَالِ حَقًّا لِأَنَّهُ مُمْتِعٌ.
أَهْوَى تَسَلُّقَ الجِبَالِ حَقًّا لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعٌ.
أَهْوَى تَسَلُّقُ الجِبَالِ حَقًّا لِأَنَّهُ مُمْتِعَةٌ.
quiz.feedback: تَسَلُّق is masculine and is the object of أَهْوَى, so the pronoun and adjective are both masculine.

grammar.common_error: Do not choose a sentence only because it contains the right hobby word. Check that the verb matches the kind of activity, that the preposition is the fixed one, and that the ending on the noun follows from its role.
grammar.challenge: Write one sentence that combines a collocation, a frequency phrase and a reason with لِأَنَّ, keeping every ending accurate.

builders.target: Build accurate free-time statements that combine a collocation, a frequency phrase and a reason.
builders.feedback: Every combination keeps the collocation, the frequency phrase and the reason accurate, so any three different sentences are correct.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: Ball game after يَلْعَبُ, and the object is accusative.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: عَلَى is fixed with يَعْزِفُ, and the instrument is genitive.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: مَرَّتَيْنِ is the dual of مَرَّةٌ, not a plural.

mistakes.why: السِّبَاحَة is an activity, not a ball game, so it takes يُمَارِسُ.
يَعْزِفُ needs the preposition عَلَى before the instrument.
Numbers from three to ten are followed by a genitive plural.

listening.title: Listening: three students describe their free time
listening.script: أَنَا سَلْمَى، وَأُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ لِأَنَّهَا تُرِيحُنِي بَعْدَ الدِّرَاسَةِ. وَفِي وَقْتِ فَرَاغِي أَقْرَأُ الرِّوَايَاتِ. أَمَّا أَخِي يُوسُفُ فَيَعْزِفُ عَلَى العُودِ يَوْمِيًّا، وَيَقُولُ إِنَّهُ يُفَضِّلُ المُوسِيقَى عَلَى الرِّيَاضَةِ. وَصَدِيقَتِي لَيْلَى تَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الشَّهْرِ فَقَطْ، لٰكِنَّهَا تَهْوَى التَّصْوِيرَ الفُوتُوغْرَافِيَّ حَقًّا.

questions.prompt: How often does Salmā swim?
questions.feedback: She says مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.prompt: Why does Salmā swim?
questions.feedback: She gives the reason لِأَنَّهَا تُرِيحُنِي بَعْدَ الدِّرَاسَةِ.

questions.prompt: What does Yūsuf do daily?
questions.feedback: The script says يَعْزِفُ عَلَى العُودِ يَوْمِيًّا.

questions.prompt: What does Yūsuf prefer?
questions.feedback: He says يُفَضِّلُ المُوسِيقَى عَلَى الرِّيَاضَةِ.

questions.prompt: What is Laylā truly passionate about?
questions.feedback: She plays basketball only occasionally but تَهْوَى التَّصْوِيرَ الفُوتُوغْرَافِيَّ حَقًّا.

reading.title: Reading: a free-time profile
reading.text: فِي وَقْتِ فَرَاغِي أُمَارِسُ رِيَاضَةَ اليُوغَا مَرَّةً فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَأَرْكَبُ الدَّرَّاجَةَ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي فِي نِهَايَةِ الأُسْبُوعِ. وَأَنَا أُفَضِّلُ الأَنْشِطَةَ الهَادِئَةَ عَلَى الأَلْعَابِ السَّرِيعَةِ، لِأَنَّنِي أَسْتَمْتِعُ بِالقِرَاءَةِ وَالرَّسْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ المُبَارَيَاتِ. وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ أُشَاهِدُ مُبَارَاةَ كُرَةِ القَدَمِ أَحْيَانًا مَعَ أَبِي، وَنَتَنَاقَشُ فِيهَا طَوِيلًا. أَمَّا هِوَايَتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ فَهِيَ الغِنَاءُ، وَأَهْوَاهُ حَقًّا لِأَنَّهُ يَجْعَلُنِي سَعِيدَةً.

questions.prompt: How often does the writer do yoga?
questions.feedback: The text says مَرَّةً فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.prompt: What does the writer prefer?
questions.feedback: أُفَضِّلُ الأَنْشِطَةَ الهَادِئَةَ عَلَى الأَلْعَابِ السَّرِيعَةِ.

questions.prompt: What does the writer do with her father?
questions.feedback: أُشَاهِدُ مُبَارَاةَ كُرَةِ القَدَمِ أَحْيَانًا مَعَ أَبِي.

questions.prompt: Which is her favourite hobby?
questions.feedback: هِوَايَتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ فَهِيَ الغِنَاءُ.

questions.prompt: Why does she love it?
questions.feedback: لِأَنَّهُ يَجْعَلُنِي سَعِيدَةً.

speaking.instruction: Speak for thirty seconds about one hobby without notes. You must include the correct collocation, one frequency phrase, one preference structure and one reason with لِأَنَّ.
prompts: مَا هِوَايَتُكَ المُفَضَّلَةُ؟ وَكَمْ مَرَّةً تُمَارِسُهَا فِي الأُسْبُوعِ؟
هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ الرِّيَاضَةَ عَلَى المُوسِيقَى؟ لِمَاذَا؟
مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ فِي وَقْتِ فَرَاغِكَ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِكَ؟
speaking.context: Speaking: my hobby in thirty seconds
model: أُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَأَسْتَمْتِعُ بِهَا كَثِيرًا.
نَعَمْ، أُفَضِّلُ السِّبَاحَةَ عَلَى القِرَاءَةِ لِأَنَّهَا تُرِيحُنِي بَعْدَ الدِّرَاسَةِ.

writing.title: Writing: eight sentences about your free time
checklist: Five different collocation verbs, each with the noun ending it requires.
Four different frequency expressions, including the dual مَرَّتَيْنِ.
All three preference structures: أُفَضِّلُ … عَلَى، أَسْتَمْتِعُ بِـ، أَهْوَى … حَقًّا.
One reason with لِأَنَّ where the pronoun matches its noun in gender.
writing.prompt: Write eight sentences about your hobbies. Use five different collocation verbs, four different frequency expressions and all three preference structures. Give a reason with لِأَنَّ for your favourite hobby.
writing.model: فِي وَقْتِ فَرَاغِي أُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَأَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ مَرَّةً فِي الأُسْبُوعِ. وَأَعْزِفُ عَلَى العُودِ يَوْمِيًّا لِأَنَّ المُوسِيقَى تُرِيحُنِي. أُفَضِّلُ الأَنْشِطَةَ الهَادِئَةَ عَلَى الأَلْعَابِ السَّرِيعَةِ، وَأَسْتَمْتِعُ بِالقِرَاءَةِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مُشَاهَدَةِ الأَفْلَامِ. أَمَّا هِوَايَتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ فَهِيَ الرَّسْمُ، وَأَهْوَاهُ حَقًّا لِأَنَّهُ يَجْعَلُنِي سَعِيدًا.

differentiation.core: Use the vocabulary vault and the sentence frames to produce six accurate sentences with one collocation and one frequency phrase each.
differentiation.develop: Link your sentences into a paragraph, adding a preference structure and a reason with لِأَنَّ.
differentiation.stretch: Compare two hobbies in one sentence, qualify your view with مَعَ ذٰلِكَ or أَمَّا … فَـ, and keep every case ending accurate.

final.feedback: Mountain climbing is a sustained activity, so it takes يُمَارِسُ.
The dual in an adverbial accusative is مَرَّتَيْنِ.

final.prompt: Choose the accurate preposition: أَسْتَمِعُ ___ المُوسِيقَى.
final.feedback: يَسْتَمِعُ is fixed with إِلَى.

options: أَهْوَى الرَّسْمَ حَقًّا لِأَنَّهُ يُرِيحُنِي، وَأُمَارِسُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
final.feedback: The accurate answer combines an object in the accusative, a matching masculine pronoun, a reason and a frequency phrase.

lessons.title: Sport — Vocabulary, Famous Athletes and Cultural Context
lessons.arabic: الرِّيَاضَةُ — المُفْرَدَاتُ وَالرِّيَاضِيُّونَ المَشْهُورُونَ وَالسِّيَاقُ الثَّقَافِيُّ
lessons.summary: Name fifteen sports, state rules with يَجِبُ and مَمْنُوعٌ, report results with فَازَ / خَسِرَ / تَعَادَلَ, and admire an athlete with يُعْجِبُنِي and أُعْجَبُ بِـ.
objectives: Name fifteen sports and use each with its correct verb.
Describe a rule using يَجِبُ عَلَى … أَنْ, يُسْمَحُ بِـ and مَمْنُوعٌ.
Report a result using the past set phrases فَازَ بِـ، فَازَ عَلَى، خَسِرَ and تَعَادَلَ.
Express admiration for an athlete using يُعْجِبُنِي and أُعْجَبُ بِـ with a reason.
success: I use فَازَ بِـ for the prize and فَازَ عَلَى for the opponent.
I follow يَجِبُ عَلَى with a person and أَنْ with a subjunctive verb.
I write an admiration sentence with a reason using لِأَنَّهُ or لِأَنَّهَا.
I recognise these past forms as past tense before the full system arrives next lesson.

items.note: The adjective agrees with the masculine noun.
أَنْ is followed by the subjunctive.
A passive verb, so it takes بِـ.

items.en: I admire it (lit. it pleases me)
items.note: The thing admired is the subject.
A passive form, fixed with بِـ.

teach.title: فَازَ بِـ and فَازَ عَلَى do different jobs
teach.text: Use بِـ for the thing won — فَازَ بِالبُطُولَةِ. Use عَلَى for the opponent beaten — فَازَ عَلَى الفَرِيقِ المِصْرِيِّ. Choosing the wrong preposition changes who or what you are talking about.

teach.title: You are already reading past tense
teach.text: فَازَ، خَسِرَ and تَعَادَلَ are past-tense verbs. Learn them as whole chunks now; next lesson you will see the system that builds them from any root.

grammar.title: Results, rules and admiration
grammar.overview: Three structures carry this lesson: reporting a result, stating a rule, and saying why you admire someone. Each has a fixed preposition or a fixed verb form — check it before you choose.

rules.heading: Reporting a win
rules.explanation: بِـ introduces what was won; عَلَى introduces who was beaten. Both are followed by the genitive.

rules.heading: Losing and drawing
rules.explanation: خَسِرَ takes a direct object or فِي with a match. تَعَادَلَ is Form VI, a mutual action, so its subject is usually dual or plural.

rules.heading: Stating a rule
rules.explanation: The person obliged follows عَلَى in the genitive; the action follows أَنْ in the subjunctive. مَمْنُوعٌ introduces a prohibition with a verbal noun.
examples: يَجِبُ عَلَى اللَّاعِبِينَ أَنْ يَحْتَرِمُوا الحَكَمَ

rules.heading: Expressing admiration
rules.explanation: With يُعْجِبُنِي the admired person is the grammatical subject. أُعْجَبُ is a passive form and is fixed with بِـ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence for beating an opponent.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate drawing sentence.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate rule.

يَجِبُ عَلَى اللَّاعِبُونَ أَنْ يَحْتَرِمُونَ الحَكَمَ.
quiz.feedback: عَلَى takes the genitive اللَّاعِبِينَ, and أَنْ takes the subjunctive يَحْتَرِمُوا.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate prohibition.
quiz.feedback: مَمْنُوعٌ is followed by a verbal noun, and لَمْسٌ is masculine.

quiz.feedback: With يُعْجِبُنِي the admired person is the subject, so it is nominative.

quiz.feedback: أُعْجَبُ is fixed with بِـ, and the noun after it is genitive.

quiz.feedback: البَطَلَة is feminine, so both the pronoun and the adjective are feminine.

patterns.tip: Genitive after عَلَى, subjunctive after أَنْ.

listening.title: Listening: a match report and an admired athlete
listening.script: فِي المُبَارَاةِ النِّهَائِيَّةِ أَمْسِ، فَازَ فَرِيقُنَا عَلَى الفَرِيقِ الضَّيْفِ بِهَدَفَيْنِ مُقَابِلَ هَدَفٍ وَاحِدٍ. وَفِي الأُسْبُوعِ الماضِي خَسِرَ الفَرِيقُ مُبَارَاتَهُ، وَقَبْلَ ذٰلِكَ تَعَادَلَ الفَرِيقَانِ فِي النِّقَاطِ. أَمَّا أَنَا فَيُعْجِبُنِي لَاعِبُنَا الجَدِيدُ كَثِيرًا، وَأُعْجَبُ بِتَوَاضُعِهِ وَاجْتِهَادِهِ، لِأَنَّهُ يَتَدَرَّبُ يَوْمِيًّا رَغْمَ نَجَاحِهِ الكَبِيرِ. وَقَدْ فَازَ بِمِيدَالِيَةٍ ذَهَبِيَّةٍ فِي بُطُولَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What was the result of yesterday's final?
questions.feedback: فَازَ فَرِيقُنَا … بِهَدَفَيْنِ مُقَابِلَ هَدَفٍ وَاحِدٍ.

questions.prompt: What happened last week?
questions.feedback: خَسِرَ الفَرِيقُ مُبَارَاتَهُ.

questions.prompt: What happened before that?
questions.feedback: تَعَادَلَ الفَرِيقَانِ فِي النِّقَاطِ.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker admire in the new player?
questions.feedback: أُعْجَبُ بِتَوَاضُعِهِ وَاجْتِهَادِهِ.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker admire him?
options: He trains daily despite his success
He plays for a foreign team

reading.title: Reading: an athlete profile
reading.text: يُعْجِبُنِي هٰذَا اللَّاعِبُ كَثِيرًا. هُوَ لَاعِبُ كُرَةِ قَدَمٍ مَشْهُورٌ يَلْعَبُ لِفَرِيقٍ أُورُوبِّيٍّ كَبِيرٍ. فَازَ بِجَوَائِزَ عَدِيدَةٍ، وَيُعْتَبَرُ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ اللَّاعِبِينَ فِي العَالَمِ. وَفِي المَوْسِمِ المَاضِي فَازَ عَلَى فِرَقٍ قَوِيَّةٍ وَسَجَّلَ أَهْدَافًا كَثِيرَةً، لٰكِنَّهُ خَسِرَ المُبَارَاةَ النِّهَائِيَّةَ. وَمَعَ ذٰلِكَ أُعْجَبُ بِهِ لِأَنَّهُ مُتَوَاضِعٌ وَمُجْتَهِدٌ رَغْمَ نَجَاحِهِ الكَبِيرِ. وَيَقُولُ دَائِمًا إِنَّ العَمَلَ الجَمَاعِيَّ أَهَمُّ مِنَ الإِنْجَازِ الفَرْدِيِّ.

questions.prompt: Which sport does he play?
questions.feedback: هُوَ لَاعِبُ كُرَةِ قَدَمٍ مَشْهُورٌ.

questions.prompt: What did he win?
questions.feedback: فَازَ بِجَوَائِزَ عَدِيدَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What happened in the final?
questions.feedback: لٰكِنَّهُ خَسِرَ المُبَارَاةَ النِّهَائِيَّةَ.

questions.prompt: Why is he admired?
questions.feedback: أُعْجَبُ بِهِ لِأَنَّهُ مُتَوَاضِعٌ وَمُجْتَهِدٌ.

questions.prompt: What does he always say?
options: Teamwork matters more than individual achievement
questions.feedback: إِنَّ العَمَلَ الجَمَاعِيَّ أَهَمُّ مِنَ الإِنْجَازِ الفَرْدِيِّ.

speaking.instruction: Speak for forty seconds about an athlete you admire. Use يُعْجِبُنِي or أُعْجَبُ بِـ, one past result phrase, one personality adjective and one reason with لِأَنَّ.
prompts: مَنِ الرِّيَاضِيُّ الَّذِي يُعْجِبُكَ؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟
مَاذَا فَازَ بِهِ فِي المَوْسِمِ المَاضِي؟
هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ الرِّيَاضَةَ الفَرْدِيَّةَ أَمِ الجَمَاعِيَّةَ؟ لِمَاذَا؟
model: يُعْجِبُنِي لَاعِبٌ مَشْهُورٌ فِي فَرِيقِنَا الوَطَنِيِّ.
فَازَ بِالمِيدَالِيَةِ الذَّهَبِيَّةِ، وَأُعْجَبُ بِتَوَاضُعِهِ لِأَنَّهُ يَتَدَرَّبُ يَوْمِيًّا.

writing.title: Writing: a seventy-word athlete profile
checklist: One result phrase from فَازَ بِـ / فَازَ عَلَى / خَسِرَ / تَعَادَلَ.
Both admiration structures: يُعْجِبُنِي and أُعْجَبُ بِـ.
Two personality adjectives that agree with their noun.
One reason with لِأَنَّ where the pronoun matches the athlete's gender.
writing.prompt: Write about seventy words on an athlete you admire: the sport played, a major achievement using فَازَ بِـ, two personality adjectives, and why you admire them using أُعْجَبُ بِـ … لِأَنَّهُ / لِأَنَّهَا.
writing.model: يُعْجِبُنِي لَاعِبُ كُرَةِ القَدَمِ فِي فَرِيقِنَا الوَطَنِيِّ كَثِيرًا. فِي المَوْسِمِ المَاضِي فَازَ بِالبُطُولَةِ، وَفَازَ فَرِيقُهُ عَلَى فِرَقٍ قَوِيَّةٍ. وَلٰكِنَّهُ خَسِرَ المُبَارَاةَ النِّهَائِيَّةَ فِي بُطُولَةٍ أُخْرَى. هُوَ مُتَوَاضِعٌ وَمُجْتَهِدٌ، وَأُعْجَبُ بِهِ لِأَنَّهُ يَحْتَرِمُ مُنَافِسِيهِ. وَفِي رَأْيِي يَجِبُ عَلَى اللَّاعِبِينَ أَنْ يَتَدَرَّبُوا بِانْتِظَامٍ.

differentiation.core: Write five sentences: three naming sports with their verbs and two reporting a result.
differentiation.develop: Link the sentences into a profile that adds an admiration structure and a reason.
differentiation.stretch: Contrast individual and team sport using رَغْمَ or مَعَ ذٰلِكَ, keeping every case ending accurate.

final.feedback: The prize won follows بِـ in the genitive.

options: يَجِبُ عَلَى اللَّاعِبِ أَنْ يَتَدَرَّبَ بِانْتِظَامٍ.
يَجِبُ عَلَى اللَّاعِبِ أَنْ يَتَدَرَّبُ بِانْتِظَامٍ.
يَجِبُ عَلَى اللَّاعِبُ أَنْ يَتَدَرَّبَ بِانْتِظَامٍ.

أُعْجَبُ takes بِـ, and the noun and its adjective are both genitive.

options: يُعْجِبُنِي هٰذَا البَطَلُ لِأَنَّهُ مُتَوَاضِعٌ، وَقَدْ فَازَ بِالبُطُولَةِ الأَخِيرَةِ.
final.feedback: The accurate answer keeps the subject nominative, matches the pronoun to the noun and uses بِـ for the title won.

lessons.title: The Past Tense — Form I Regular Singular Verbs
lessons.arabic: الفِعْلُ المَاضِي — أَفْعَالُ البَابِ الأَوَّلِ المُنْتَظِمَةُ (المُفْرَدُ)
lessons.summary: The D5 grammar milestone: build the past tense of any regular Form I verb for all five singular persons, and anchor it with six past time expressions.
objectives: Form the past tense of regular Form I verbs for all five singular persons.
Apply the suffix system: أَنَا ـتُ، أَنْتَ ـتَ، أَنْتِ ـتِ، هُوَ with no suffix، هِيَ ـَتْ.
Recognise both sub-patterns, فَعَلَ and فَعِلَ, and keep the middle vowel accurate.
Place a past time expression at the start of the sentence and keep the verb in the past.
success: I keep the root constant and change only the suffix.
I distinguish ـتُ, ـتَ and ـتِ by their short vowel.
I write هِيَ forms with ـَتْ and not with the أَنَا ending.
I contrast present, past and future for the same verb without confusing them.

items.note: The middle consonant carries a fatḥa.
The middle consonant carries a kasra.
فَعِلَ pattern — kasra on the middle letter.
Form III, but the suffixes are identical.
The hamza keeps its seat: قَرَأْتُ.
المَاضِي keeps its yāʾ after فِي.

teach.title: The root stays, the suffix moves
teach.text: In لَعِبْتُ، لَعِبْتَ، لَعِبْتِ، لَعِبَ، لَعِبَتْ the letters ل ع ب never change. Only the ending changes, and the ending is what tells your reader who did the action.

teach.title: Three short vowels do the hardest work
teach.text: ـتُ is أَنَا, ـتَ is أَنْتَ and ـتِ is أَنْتِ. The consonants are identical; only the short vowel separates them. Write the vowel every time or your reader cannot tell who you mean.

grammar.title: The past-tense suffix system
grammar.overview: One root, five endings. Learn the endings as a set, then attach them to any regular Form I verb. Watch the middle vowel: فَعَلَ verbs keep a fatḥa, فَعِلَ verbs keep a kasra.

rules.heading: هُوَ and هِيَ
rules.explanation: The هُوَ form is the bare past tense. The هِيَ form adds ـَتْ with a sukūn on the tāʾ.

rules.heading: أَنَا
rules.explanation: The tāʾ carries a ḍamma. The letter before it takes a sukūn.

rules.heading: أَنْتَ and أَنْتِ
rules.explanation: Same consonants as the أَنَا form; only the final short vowel differs. A fatḥa addresses a male, a kasra a female.

rules.heading: Past time expressions come first
rules.explanation: Arabic normally opens the sentence with the past time expression. The verb stays in the past whatever the expression.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate أَنَا form of لَعِبَ.
quiz.feedback: The أَنَا suffix is ـْتُ with a ḍamma.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate هِيَ form of ذَهَبَ.
quiz.feedback: The هِيَ suffix is ـَتْ, with a fatḥa before the tāʾ and a sukūn on it.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence addresses one female accurately?
quiz.feedback: Addressing أَنْتِ requires the kasra ending ـْتِ.

quiz.prompt: Complete: أَمْسِ ___ سَلْمَى فِي الحَدِيقَةِ.
quiz.feedback: سَلْمَى is هِيَ, so the verb takes ـَتْ.

quiz.prompt: Which verb follows the فَعِلَ pattern?
quiz.feedback: شَرِبَ carries a kasra on its middle letter.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate past sentence with a time expression.
quiz.feedback: The time phrase is adverbial and accusative, and the verb must be past.

quiz.prompt: Complete: ___ أُسْبُوعٍ قَرَأْتُ كِتَابًا مُمْتِعًا.
quiz.feedback: مُنْذُ is followed by a genitive noun and suits a completed period.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate three-tense set for سَبَحَ.
quiz.feedback: For هِيَ the present is تَسْبَحُ, the past سَبَحَتْ and the future سَتَسْبَحُ.

grammar.common_error: The أَنَا, أَنْتَ and أَنْتِ forms share the same consonants. If you leave the final short vowel off, your reader cannot tell who performed the action. Write it every time.
grammar.challenge: Write one sentence that opens with a past time expression, uses a هِيَ past verb, and adds a reason with لِأَنَّ.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: Identical consonants; only the final short vowel changes the person.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: The هِيَ suffix is ـَتْ with a sukūn on the tāʾ.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: The past time expression opens the sentence.

سَلْمَى is هِيَ, so the suffix is ـَتْ, not the أَنَا ending.

lessons.title: Past Tense — Plural Forms and Irregular Verbs
lessons.arabic: الفِعْلُ المَاضِي — صِيَغُ الجَمْعِ وَالأَفْعَالُ الشَّاذَّةُ
lessons.summary: Add the three plural suffixes to the past-tense system, then handle hollow, weak-final and doubled verbs so you can write a group narrative.
objectives: Form the past tense for plural subjects: نَحْنُ ـنَا، أَنْتُمْ ـتُمْ، هُمْ ـُوا.
Use common irregular past verbs: hollow قُلْنَا, weak-final مَشَيْنَا and رَأَيْنَا, doubled غَنَّيْنَا.
Shift a narrative from an individual account to a shared one.
Write a group narrative of eighty to ninety words in the past tense.
success: I use ـنَا for نَحْنُ and ـُوا for هُمْ without confusing them.
I shorten the middle vowel of a hollow verb before a consonant suffix: قَالَ becomes قُلْنَا.
I write weak-final verbs with yāʾ before the suffix: مَشَى becomes مَشَيْنَا.
I keep every verb in my group narrative in the past tense.

items.note: The هُمْ suffix is ـُوا; the alif is silent.
Hollow: the long ā shortens to u before a consonant suffix.
Hollow with a kasra base vowel.
Weak-final: the alif maqṣūra becomes yāʾ.
Form II with a doubled middle letter and a weak final.
Both noun and adjective are accusative.

teach.title: ـنَا turns your story into our story
teach.text: Swapping لَعِبْتُ for لَعِبْنَا moves the account from one person to a group. Plural past tense is the language of team sport, family holidays and shared memories.

teach.title: Irregular verbs are regular in their endings
teach.text: The suffixes never change. What changes is the stem: قَالَ shortens to قُلْـ, and مَشَى takes a yāʾ to become مَشَيْـ. Learn the stem change once and the endings follow the usual pattern.

grammar.title: Plural suffixes and irregular stems
grammar.overview: Three new suffixes complete the past-tense system. Then three families of irregular verb change their stem before those suffixes. Identify the family first, adjust the stem, then attach the ending.

rules.heading: The three plural suffixes
rules.formula: نَحْنُ → ـنَا · أَنْتُمْ → ـتُمْ · هُمْ → ـُوا
rules.explanation: The نَحْنُ and أَنْتُمْ suffixes begin with a consonant; the هُمْ suffix is a long ū written with a silent alif.

rules.heading: Hollow verbs
rules.explanation: A verb whose middle letter is a long vowel shortens that vowel before a consonant suffix. The short vowel matches the verb's own family: u for قَالَ, i for نَامَ.

rules.heading: Weak-final verbs
rules.explanation: A verb ending in alif maqṣūra replaces it with yāʾ before a consonant suffix.

rules.heading: هُمْ with a weak-final verb
rules.explanation: With هُمْ a regular verb takes ـُوا. A weak-final verb loses its final vowel letter and takes ـَوْا instead.

teach.title: كَانَ changes the ending of what follows
teach.text: The subject of كَانَ stays nominative, but its predicate becomes accusative: كَانَ الطَّقْسُ جَمِيلًا, كَانَتِ المُبَارَاةُ صَعْبَةً. This single ending is the most common accuracy marker in Arabic narrative writing.

teach.title: Connectors carry the shape of the story
teach.text: فِي البِدَايَةِ sets the scene, ثُمَّ moves it forward, فَجْأَةً marks the turn, and فِي النِّهَايَةِ resolves it. Place one at each stage and the reader can follow the arc without effort.

grammar.title: كَانَ, the past habit, and the narrative arc
grammar.overview: Two structures build the story and one set of connectors shapes it. Watch the ending on the predicate of كَانَ, and keep the second verb in the present when you mean a past habit.

rules.heading: كَانَ with a description
rules.explanation: The predicate of كَانَ takes the accusative. This applies to adjectives and to nouns.

rules.heading: كَانَ with a present verb
rules.explanation: This expresses a repeated or ongoing past action. Both verbs agree with the same subject; only كَانَ carries the past.
examples: كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ

rules.heading: كَانَ is a hollow verb
rules.explanation: Before a consonant suffix the long ā shortens to u, exactly as with قَالَ.

rules.heading: The narrative arc
rules.explanation: فِي البِدَايَةِ opens, ثُمَّ continues, فَجْأَةً or فِي تِلْكَ اللَّحْظَةِ marks the turn, and فِي النِّهَايَةِ or أَخِيرًا closes.
examples: فِي البِدَايَةِ كَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَادِئًا

rounds.prompt: Verb form: which is the هُمْ past habit of يَتَدَرَّبُ?
rounds.feedback: كَانُوا agrees with هُمْ and the second verb stays present.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “at that moment”?
rounds.feedback: فِي تِلْكَ اللَّحْظَةِ means at that moment.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence keeps the tense system consistent?
options: كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، ثُمَّ تَوَقَّفْتُ.
كُنْتُ لَعِبْتُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، ثُمَّ تَوَقَّفْتُ.
أَكُونُ أَلْعَبُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، ثُمَّ تَوَقَّفْتُ.
rounds.feedback: The habit uses كُنْتُ plus a present verb; the single completed action stays past.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which answer tells the fullest story?
options: فِي البِدَايَةِ كَانَ الجَوُّ هَادِئًا، ثُمَّ فَجْأَةً بَدَأَ المَطَرُ، وَفِي النِّهَايَةِ عُدْنَا سُعَدَاءَ.
فِي البِدَايَةِ كَانَ الجَوُّ هَادِئٌ وَعُدْنَا.
rounds.feedback: The full answer moves through setting, turn and resolution with accurate endings.

builder_tasks.title: Correct the predicate of كَانَ
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the ending on the describing word.
builder_tasks.source: كَانَ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدٌ فِي ذٰلِكَ الصَّبَاحِ.
options: كَانَ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدًا فِي ذٰلِكَ الصَّبَاحِ.
كَانَ الطَّقْسَ بَارِدًا فِي ذٰلِكَ الصَّبَاحِ.
كَانَ الطَّقْسُ بَارِدٍ فِي ذٰلِكَ الصَّبَاحِ.
builder_tasks.feedback: The subject stays nominative and the predicate takes the accusative.

builder_tasks.title: Turn a single action into a habit
builder_tasks.instruction: Rewrite so the sentence describes what he used to do.
options: كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
كَانَ لَعِبَ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
يَكُونُ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
builder_tasks.feedback: A past habit is كَانَ plus a present-tense verb.

builder_tasks.title: Add the turning point
builder_tasks.instruction: Insert the connector that marks a sudden change.
builder_tasks.source: كَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَادِئًا، ثُمَّ تَغَيَّرَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ.
options: كَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَادِئًا، وَفَجْأَةً تَغَيَّرَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ.
كَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَادِئًا، وَأَخِيرًا تَغَيَّرَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ.
كَانَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ هَادِئًا، وَفِي البِدَايَةِ تَغَيَّرَ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ.
builder_tasks.feedback: فَجْأَةً is the connector that marks a sudden turn.

lessons.title: Music, Arts and Arabic Culture
lessons.summary: Name Arabic instruments and art forms, describe a cultural experience in the past tense, and express appreciation with يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ، يُؤَثِّرُ فِي and يُلْهِمُ.
objectives: Name Arabic musical instruments and art forms with precise vocabulary.
Describe a concert, exhibition or performance using the past tense.
Express cultural appreciation with يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ، يُؤَثِّرُ فِي and يُلْهِمُ.
Use the past forms عَبَّرَ عَنْ، أَثَّرَ فِي and أَلْهَمَ in a written account.
success: I follow يُعَبِّرُ with عَنْ and يُؤَثِّرُ with فِي, each taking the genitive.
I use يُلْهِمُ with a direct object in the accusative.
I describe a past cultural event with accurate past-tense verbs.
I write about heritage without claiming that one form suits everyone.

items.note: A short-necked lute, central to Arabic music.

teach.title: Each verb keeps its own preposition
teach.text: يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ, يُؤَثِّرُ فِي, and يُلْهِمُ with a direct object. Learn the verb and its preposition together; swapping them is the most common error in this topic.

teach.title: Describe variety, not a single rule
teach.text: Musical taste and artistic tradition differ across and within Arabic-speaking countries. Use فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ، أَحْيَانًا and لَيْسَ دَائِمًا so your Arabic reports what you observed rather than turning one experience into a rule about everyone.

grammar.title: Expressing influence and appreciation
grammar.overview: Three Form II and Form IV verbs carry this lesson, each with its own complement. Add the past forms and you can describe a cultural experience precisely.

rules.heading: يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ
rules.explanation: Form II with عَنْ. The thing expressed follows the preposition and is genitive.

rules.heading: يُؤَثِّرُ فِي
rules.explanation: Form II with فِي. Use it for lasting influence on a person, a style or a generation.

rules.heading: يُلْهِمُ with a direct object
rules.explanation: Form IV takes a direct object with no preposition.

rules.heading: Hedged cultural statements
rules.formula: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ / أَحْيَانًا / لَيْسَ دَائِمًا
rules.explanation: Qualify a cultural observation so it describes some people or some places rather than everyone.
examples: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ يَتَعَلَّمُ الأَطْفَالُ العُودَ مُبَكِّرًا

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with يُعَبِّرُ.
quiz.feedback: يُعَبِّرُ is fixed with عَنْ, and the noun after it is genitive.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with أَثَّرَ.
quiz.feedback: يُؤَثِّرُ takes فِي with the genitive.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence with أَلْهَمَ.
quiz.feedback: أَلْهَمَ takes a direct object in the accusative.

quiz.prompt: Which word names a reed flute?
quiz.feedback: النَّايُ is the reed flute.

quiz.prompt: Complete: ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى ___ مُوسِيقِيَّةٍ فِي المَسْرَحِ.
quiz.feedback: إِلَى takes the genitive, and the adjective agrees.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate past account.
quiz.feedback: فِرْقَة is feminine, and يَعْزِفُ takes عَلَى with the genitive.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurately hedged statement.
options: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ يَتَعَلَّمُ الأَطْفَالُ العُودَ مُبَكِّرًا.
quiz.feedback: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ describes some places without turning it into a rule about everyone.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate agreement.
quiz.feedback: زَخْرَفَة is feminine, so both adjectives are feminine and nominative.

grammar.common_error: Do not swap the prepositions. عَنْ belongs to يُعَبِّرُ, فِي belongs to يُؤَثِّرُ, and يُلْهِمُ takes no preposition at all.
grammar.challenge: Write one sentence that says what a form of art expresses and one that says whom it influenced, keeping both complements accurate.

builders.target: Build accurate cultural statements from a subject, an influence verb and a complement.
builders.feedback: Each opening clause, complement and hedged closing is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations work.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: عَنْ is fixed with يُعَبِّرُ and takes the genitive.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: فِي is fixed with يُؤَثِّرُ.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: يُلْهِمُ takes a direct accusative object.

mistakes.why: يُعَبِّرُ requires عَنْ.
يُؤَثِّرُ requires فِي.
يُلْهِمُ takes a direct object without a preposition.

listening.title: Listening: an evening at a heritage concert
listening.script: فِي الأُسْبُوعِ المَاضِي ذَهَبْتُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي إِلَى حَفْلَةٍ مُوسِيقِيَّةٍ فِي المَسْرَحِ الكَبِيرِ. كَانَتِ الفِرْقَةُ صَغِيرَةً، وَعَزَفَتْ عَلَى العُودِ وَالنَّايِ وَالقَانُونِ. عَبَّرَتِ المُوسِيقَى عَنْ مَشَاعِرَ كَثِيرَةٍ، وَأَثَّرَتْ فِي الجُمْهُورِ تَأْثِيرًا وَاضِحًا. وَبَعْدَ الحَفْلَةِ زُرْنَا مَعْرِضًا لِلْخَطِّ العَرَبِيِّ، وَأَلْهَمَتْنِي الزَّخْرَفَةُ حَقًّا. فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ يَتَعَلَّمُ الأَطْفَالُ هٰذِهِ الآلَاتِ مُبَكِّرًا، وَلٰكِنْ لَيْسَ دَائِمًا؛ فَالأَذْوَاقُ تَخْتَلِفُ مِنْ أُسْرَةٍ إِلَى أُسْرَةٍ.

questions.prompt: Where was the concert?
questions.feedback: حَفْلَةٍ مُوسِيقِيَّةٍ فِي المَسْرَحِ الكَبِيرِ.

questions.prompt: Which instruments did the ensemble play?
questions.feedback: عَزَفَتْ عَلَى العُودِ وَالنَّايِ وَالقَانُونِ.

questions.prompt: What did the music do to the audience?
questions.feedback: أَثَّرَتْ فِي الجُمْهُورِ تَأْثِيرًا وَاضِحًا.

questions.prompt: What did they visit after the concert?
questions.feedback: زُرْنَا مَعْرِضًا لِلْخَطِّ العَرَبِيِّ.

questions.prompt: How does the speaker qualify the final statement?
options: Tastes differ from family to family
questions.feedback: لَيْسَ دَائِمًا؛ فَالأَذْوَاقُ تَخْتَلِفُ مِنْ أُسْرَةٍ إِلَى أُسْرَةٍ.

reading.title: Reading: why heritage music still matters
reading.text: تُعَبِّرُ المُوسِيقَى العَرَبِيَّةُ عَنْ تَارِيخٍ طَوِيلٍ وَعَنْ مَشَاعِرَ إِنْسَانِيَّةٍ مُشْتَرَكَةٍ. وَقَدْ أَثَّرَتْ آلَاتٌ مِثْلُ العُودِ فِي مُوسِيقَى مَنَاطِقَ كَثِيرَةٍ خَارِجَ العَالَمِ العَرَبِيِّ. وَفِي كُلِّ مَرْحَلَةٍ ظَهَرَ مُوسِيقَارُونَ أَلْهَمُوا جِيلًا جَدِيدًا. أَمَّا الخَطُّ العَرَبِيُّ فَهُوَ فَنٌّ بَصَرِيٌّ، وَالزَّخْرَفَةُ فِيهِ تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى صَبْرٍ وَدِقَّةٍ. فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ تُدَرَّسُ هٰذِهِ الفُنُونُ فِي المَدَارِسِ، وَأَحْيَانًا يَتَعَلَّمُهَا الشَّبَابُ فِي مَرَاكِزَ ثَقَافِيَّةٍ. وَلَيْسَ دَائِمًا يُفَضِّلُ الشَّبَابُ التُّرَاثَ عَلَى المُوسِيقَى الحَدِيثَةِ، فَالذَّوْقُ شَخْصِيٌّ.

questions.prompt: What does Arabic music express?
options: A long history and shared human feelings
questions.feedback: تُعَبِّرُ … عَنْ تَارِيخٍ طَوِيلٍ وَعَنْ مَشَاعِرَ إِنْسَانِيَّةٍ مُشْتَرَكَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What has the oud influenced?
options: Music in many regions beyond the Arab world
questions.feedback: أَثَّرَتْ آلَاتٌ مِثْلُ العُودِ فِي مُوسِيقَى مَنَاطِقَ كَثِيرَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What does calligraphy require?
questions.feedback: تَحْتَاجُ إِلَى صَبْرٍ وَدِقَّةٍ.

questions.prompt: Where are these arts taught?
options: In schools in some countries, and sometimes in cultural centres
questions.feedback: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ تُدَرَّسُ … وَأَحْيَانًا … فِي مَرَاكِزَ ثَقَافِيَّةٍ.

questions.prompt: What does the text say about young people's taste?
options: They do not always prefer heritage to modern music
questions.feedback: وَلَيْسَ دَائِمًا يُفَضِّلُ الشَّبَابُ التُّرَاثَ … فَالذَّوْقُ شَخْصِيٌّ.

prompts: صِفْ حَفْلَةً مُوسِيقِيَّةً أَوْ مَعْرِضًا زُرْتَهُ. مَاذَا رَأَيْتَ وَسَمِعْتَ؟
أَيُّ آلَةٍ مُوسِيقِيَّةٍ تُعْجِبُكَ؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟
هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ المُوسِيقَى التُّرَاثِيَّةَ أَمِ الحَدِيثَةَ؟ اِسْتَعْمِلْ أَحْيَانًا وَلَيْسَ دَائِمًا.
model: يُعْجِبُنِي العُودُ لِأَنَّهُ يُعَبِّرُ عَنِ المَشَاعِرِ بِوُضُوحٍ.
نَعَمْ، فِي الأُسْبُوعِ المَاضِي حَضَرْتُ حَفْلَةً أَلْهَمَتْنِي حَقًّا، وَلٰكِنْ لَيْسَ دَائِمًا أُفَضِّلُ التُّرَاثَ.

writing.prompt: Write about eighty words describing a cultural experience: a concert, an exhibition or a performance. Say what it expressed, whom or what it influenced, and add one hedged statement about taste using فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ، أَحْيَانًا or لَيْسَ دَائِمًا.
checklist: One sentence with يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ or عَبَّرَ عَنْ.
One sentence with يُؤَثِّرُ فِي or أَثَّرَ فِي.
One sentence with يُلْهِمُ or أَلْهَمَ and a direct object.
One hedged cultural statement rather than a generalisation.
writing.model: فِي الشَّهْرِ المَاضِي حَضَرْتُ حَفْلَةً مُوسِيقِيَّةً فِي المَسْرَحِ. كَانَتِ الفِرْقَةُ صَغِيرَةً، وَعَزَفَتْ عَلَى العُودِ وَالنَّايِ. عَبَّرَتِ المُوسِيقَى عَنْ مَشَاعِرَ عَمِيقَةٍ، وَأَثَّرَتْ فِي الجُمْهُورِ كَثِيرًا. وَبَعْدَ الحَفْلَةِ زُرْتُ مَعْرِضًا لِلْخَطِّ العَرَبِيِّ، وَأَلْهَمَتْنِي الزَّخْرَفَةُ حَقًّا. فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ يَتَعَلَّمُ الأَطْفَالُ هٰذِهِ الآلَاتِ مُبَكِّرًا، وَأَحْيَانًا يُفَضِّلُ الشَّبَابُ المُوسِيقَى الحَدِيثَةَ، وَلَيْسَ دَائِمًا؛ فَالذَّوْقُ شَخْصِيٌّ.

differentiation.core: Write five sentences naming instruments and art forms with accurate agreement.
differentiation.develop: Add يُعَبِّرُ عَنْ and يُؤَثِّرُ فِي with their correct prepositions.
differentiation.stretch: Add يُلْهِمُ with a direct object and a hedged comparison of heritage and modern taste.

final.prompt: Choose the accurate preposition: تُعَبِّرُ اللَّوْحَةُ ___ فِكْرَةٍ عَمِيقَةٍ.
final.feedback: يُعَبِّرُ is fixed with عَنْ.

final.prompt: Choose the accurate preposition: أَثَّرَ الخَطُّ العَرَبِيُّ ___ الفَنِّ الحَدِيثِ.
final.feedback: يُؤَثِّرُ is fixed with فِي.

final.prompt: Choose the accurate object after أَلْهَمَ.
final.feedback: يُلْهِمُ takes a direct object, here the attached pronoun ـنِي.

final.prompt: Choose the statement that avoids over-generalising.
options: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ يُفَضِّلُ النَّاسُ التُّرَاثَ.
final.feedback: فِي بَعْضِ البُلْدَانِ reports variation instead of asserting one rule for everyone.

mission.title: Culture Mission — Instruments, Influence and Hedged Opinion
mission.intro: Check the preposition, the agreement and whether the statement describes some people or claims to describe everyone.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which is the frame drum?
rounds.feedback: الدُّفُّ is the frame drum.

rounds.prompt: Preposition: complete — يُعَبِّرُ الفَنَّانُ ___ رَأْيِهِ.
rounds.feedback: يُعَبِّرُ takes عَنْ.

rounds.prompt: Preposition: complete — تُؤَثِّرُ الأُغْنِيَةُ ___ الجُمْهُورِ.
rounds.feedback: يُؤَثِّرُ takes فِي.

rounds.prompt: Verb form: which is the past of يُلْهِمُ?
rounds.feedback: The Form IV past is أَلْهَمَ.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “exhibition”?
rounds.feedback: مَعْرِضٌ is an exhibition.

rounds.prompt: Agreement: complete — الفِرْقَةُ المُوسِيقِيَّةُ ___.
rounds.feedback: فِرْقَة is feminine and nominative here.

rounds.prompt: Collocation: complete — عَزَفَتْ ___ القَانُونِ.
rounds.feedback: يَعْزِفُ takes عَلَى with the instrument.

rounds.prompt: Hedging: which sentence describes variation?
rounds.feedback: أَحْيَانًا reports that this happens some of the time.

rounds.prompt: Verb form: which is the هِيَ past of عَبَّرَ?
rounds.feedback: A feminine singular subject takes ـَتْ.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “musical heritage”?
rounds.feedback: تُرَاثٌ مُوسِيقِيٌّ is musical heritage.

rounds.prompt: Past tense: complete — فِي الأُسْبُوعِ المَاضِي ___ مَعْرِضًا.
rounds.feedback: A past time expression requires the past tense; زَارَ is hollow, giving زُرْتُ.

rounds.prompt: Object: which sentence uses يُلْهِمُ accurately?
rounds.feedback: يُلْهِمُ takes a direct accusative object.

rounds.prompt: Agreement: complete — الخَطُّ العَرَبِيُّ فَنٌّ ___.
rounds.feedback: فَنٌّ is masculine and nominative.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which answer is the most complete?
options: عَبَّرَتِ الحَفْلَةُ عَنِ التُّرَاثِ وَأَلْهَمَتْنِي حَقًّا، وَلٰكِنْ لَيْسَ دَائِمًا يُفَضِّلُ الجَمِيعُ هٰذَا النَّوْعَ.
عَبَّرَتِ الحَفْلَةُ فِي التُّرَاثِ وَأَلْهَمَتْ فِيَّ.

teach.title: Hollow travel verbs shorten before the suffix
teach.text: زَارَ، أَقَامَ and عَادَ all carry a long vowel in the middle. Before a consonant suffix it shortens: زُرْتُ، أَقَمْتُ، عُدْنَا. This is the same rule you met with قَالَ in Lesson 4.

teach.title: One account, two tenses
teach.text: Narrate what happened in the past, then switch cleanly to سَـ or سَوْفَ for what you plan next. Examiners reward this contrast, but only when each tense stays where it belongs.

grammar.title: Past narrative and future plans
grammar.overview: Travel verbs bring three challenges at once: hollow stems, fixed prepositions, and a clean switch to the future. Deal with them one at a time.

rules.heading: Hollow verbs in the past
rules.formula: زَارَ → زُرْتُ · أَقَامَ → أَقَمْتُ · عَادَ → عُدْنَا
rules.explanation: Before a consonant suffix the long middle vowel shortens. The bare هُوَ form keeps the long vowel.

rules.heading: Fixed prepositions on travel verbs
rules.formula: سَافَرَ إِلَى · أَقَامَ فِي · نَزَلَ فِي · اسْتَمْتَعَ بِـ
rules.explanation: Each verb keeps its own preposition, and the noun after it is genitive.

rules.heading: Marking the future
rules.formula: سَـ + present verb  /  سَوْفَ + present verb
rules.explanation: سَـ attaches directly to the verb; سَوْفَ stands separately and is slightly more emphatic.

rules.heading: Evaluating the trip
rules.explanation: مِنْ plus a superlative introduces the group the thing belongs to; the noun after the superlative is genitive.

listening.title: Listening: last summer's trip
listening.script: فِي الصَّيْفِ المَاضِي سَافَرْنَا إِلَى مَدِينَةٍ سَاحِلِيَّةٍ. حَجَزْنَا التَّذَاكِرَ قَبْلَ شَهْرٍ، ثُمَّ رَكِبْنَا القِطَارَ مِنَ المَحَطَّةِ. أَقَمْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ صَغِيرٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الشَّاطِئِ. فِي اليَوْمِ الأَوَّلِ زُرْنَا المَعَالِمَ السِّيَاحِيَّةَ وَاكْتَشَفْنَا سُوقًا قَدِيمًا جَمِيلًا. اسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِالرِّحْلَةِ كَثِيرًا، وَكَانَتْ مِنْ أَجْمَلِ الرِّحْلَاتِ. لِلْأَسَفِ نَسِيتُ حَقِيبَةَ السَّفَرِ فِي المَحَطَّةِ، وَلٰكِنْ لِحُسْنِ الحَظِّ وَجَدْنَاهَا. فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأَزُورُ تِلْكَ المَدِينَةَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، وَسَوْفَ نَحْجِزُ مُبَكِّرًا.

questions.prompt: When did they book the tickets?
questions.feedback: حَجَزْنَا التَّذَاكِرَ قَبْلَ شَهْرٍ.

questions.prompt: Where did they stay?
options: A small hotel near the beach
questions.feedback: أَقَمْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ صَغِيرٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الشَّاطِئِ.

questions.prompt: What did they discover?
questions.feedback: اكْتَشَفْنَا سُوقًا قَدِيمًا جَمِيلًا.

questions.prompt: What went wrong?

questions.feedback: نَسِيتُ حَقِيبَةَ السَّفَرِ فِي المَحَطَّةِ.

questions.prompt: What is the future plan?

questions.feedback: سَأَزُورُ تِلْكَ المَدِينَةَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، وَسَوْفَ نَحْجِزُ مُبَكِّرًا.

reading.title: Reading: a short travel review
reading.text: زُرْتُ هٰذِهِ المَدِينَةَ فِي الرَّبِيعِ المَاضِي مَعَ صَدِيقَيْنِ. حَجَزْنَا الفُنْدُقَ عَبْرَ الإِنْتِرْنِتْ، وَنَزَلْنَا فِي غُرْفَةٍ بَسِيطَةٍ وَنَظِيفَةٍ. كَانَ المَطَارُ بَعِيدًا قَلِيلًا، وَلٰكِنَّ القِطَارَ كَانَ سَرِيعًا وَرَخِيصًا. فِي الصَّبَاحِ كُنَّا نَمْشِي إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ، وَفِي المَسَاءِ كُنَّا نَتَنَاوَلُ العَشَاءَ فِي مَطَاعِمَ صَغِيرَةٍ. اكْتَشَفْنَا مَعَالِمَ سِيَاحِيَّةً كَثِيرَةً، وَاسْتَمْتَعْنَا بِالجَوِّ الهَادِئِ. كَانَتْ رِحْلَةً لَا تُنْسَى، وَأَنْصَحُ بِزِيَارَتِهَا فِي الرَّبِيعِ. فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَوْفَ أَعُودُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.

questions.prompt: How did they book the hotel?
questions.feedback: حَجَزْنَا الفُنْدُقَ عَبْرَ الإِنْتِرْنِتْ.

questions.prompt: What is said about the train?
questions.feedback: كَانَ القِطَارُ سَرِيعًا وَرَخِيصًا.

questions.prompt: What did they used to do in the mornings?
questions.feedback: كُنَّا نَمْشِي إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ — كَانَ plus a present verb.

questions.prompt: What does the writer recommend?
questions.feedback: أَنْصَحُ بِزِيَارَتِهَا فِي الرَّبِيعِ.

questions.prompt: What is the future intention?
questions.feedback: فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَوْفَ أَعُودُ مَعَ أُسْرَتِي.

teach.title: Verb clusters name the text type
teach.text: A run of فَعَلَ and فَعَلَتْ forms usually signals a biography or event report. A run of فَعَلْتُ and فَعَلْنَا signals a personal account or review. Reading the verb endings first tells you what kind of text you are in before you read for detail.

teach.title: Time expressions confirm what the suffixes suggest
teach.text: أَمْسِ، الأُسْبُوعَ المَاضِيَ and فِي العَامِ المَاضِي are the reading equivalent of the past suffix. When a gap-fill asks you to choose a verb, the nearest time expression is usually the deciding evidence.

grammar.title: Reading past-tense texts with evidence
grammar.overview: Three moves make these texts manageable: identify the text type from the verbs, follow the sequence with the connectors, and prove each answer from the Arabic.

rules.heading: Third-person clusters
rules.explanation: A text built on third-person past verbs is usually about someone else: a biography, a report or a news item.

rules.heading: First-person clusters
rules.explanation: A text built on first-person past verbs is a personal account, a review or a diary.

rules.heading: Sequence markers
rules.formula: فِي البِدَايَةِ … ثُمَّ … بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ … فِي النِّهَايَةِ
rules.explanation: These fix the order of events. A question about what happened first or last is usually answered by locating one of them.

rules.heading: Choosing the tense in a gap-fill
rules.explanation: Find the nearest time expression. A past marker requires a past verb; فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ or غَدًا requires سَـ with a present verb.
examples: فِي العَامِ المَاضِي انْتَقَلَ إِلَى نَادٍ جَدِيدٍ

quiz.feedback: فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ requires سَـ with a present verb.

quiz.prompt: Complete: يُشِيرُ النَّصُّ ___ أَهَمِّيَّةِ التَّدْرِيبِ.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate agreement.

listening.title: Listening: an activity report from the sports club
listening.script: فِي البِدَايَةِ نَظَّمَ النَّادِي بُطُولَةً صَغِيرَةً لِلشَّبَابِ فِي العَامِ المَاضِي. شَارَكَ فِيهَا سِتُّونَ لَاعِبًا مِنْ مَدَارِسَ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ. ثُمَّ لَعِبَتِ الفِرَقُ ثَلَاثَ مُبَارَيَاتٍ فِي كُلِّ أُسْبُوعٍ. فَازَ فَرِيقُ المَدْرَسَةِ الشَّرْقِيَّةِ بِالمُبَارَاةِ النِّهَائِيَّةِ، وَتَعَادَلَ فَرِيقَانِ فِي المَرْكَزِ الثَّالِثِ. بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ وَزَّعَ المُدِيرُ المِيدَالِيَاتِ عَلَى اللَّاعِبِينَ. وَفِي النِّهَايَةِ شَكَرَ المُدَرِّبِينَ وَالأُسَرَ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَيُنَظِّمُ النَّادِي بُطُولَةً أَكْبَرَ.

questions.feedback: Third-person past verbs about an organisation signal a report.

questions.feedback: شَارَكَ فِيهَا سِتُّونَ لَاعِبًا.

questions.feedback: فَازَ فَرِيقُ المَدْرَسَةِ الشَّرْقِيَّةِ بِالمُبَارَاةِ النِّهَائِيَّةِ.

questions.feedback: فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَيُنَظِّمُ النَّادِي بُطُولَةً أَكْبَرَ.

reading.title: Reading: a sporting life story
reading.text: بَدَأَ مَسِيرَتَهُ الرِّيَاضِيَّةَ مُنْذُ سَنَوَاتٍ، وَكَانَ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ يَتَدَرَّبُ فِي نَادٍ صَغِيرٍ قُرْبَ بَيْتِهِ. فِي البِدَايَةِ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَشْهُورًا، وَلٰكِنَّهُ تَدَرَّبَ يَوْمِيًّا وَلَمْ يَسْتَسْلِمْ. ثُمَّ انْتَقَلَ إِلَى فَرِيقٍ أَكْبَرَ، وَفِي العَامِ المَاضِي فَازَ بِالمِيدَالِيَةِ الذَّهَبِيَّةِ فِي بُطُولَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ. وَقَدْ أَثَّرَ فِي جِيلٍ كَامِلٍ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ الصِّغَارِ. بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ اعْتَزَلَ اللَّعِبَ، وَفِي النِّهَايَةِ عَادَ إِلَى نَادِيهِ الأَوَّلِ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَيُدَرِّبُ الشَّبَابَ هُنَاكَ.

questions.prompt: What happened last year?
questions.feedback: فِي العَامِ المَاضِي فَازَ بِالمِيدَالِيَةِ الذَّهَبِيَّةِ.

questions.prompt: What does the text say about his influence?
options: He influenced a whole generation of young players
He influenced only his own team
questions.feedback: أَثَّرَ فِي جِيلٍ كَامِلٍ مِنَ اللَّاعِبِينَ الصِّغَارِ.

questions.prompt: What will he do in the future?
options: Coach young people at his first club
questions.feedback: وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَيُدَرِّبُ الشَّبَابَ هُنَاكَ.

lessons.summary: Build a 130–140 word leisure text that moves through past, present and future, and mark it against the three Paper 4 Q3 criteria.
objectives: Write 130 to 140 words on leisure, sport or a past experience.
Show tense variety: at least six past verbs, three present and two future.
Structure the response as past experience, present habit, then future plan.
Apply the Task Completion, Range and Accuracy criteria to your own draft.

I mark the future with سَـ or سَوْفَ at least twice.
I use a narrative connector and one كَانَ description.
I check the collocation preposition on every hobby verb before submitting.

teach.title: Range means moving between tenses, not adding long words
teach.text: The Range criterion rewards a text that narrates in the past, describes a habit in the present and states a plan in the future. Three tenses handled accurately score higher than one tense decorated with unusual vocabulary.

teach.title: Mark your own draft before you hand it in
teach.text: Count your past verbs, check each suffix, check every hobby collocation and confirm the word count. Most marks lost at this level are lost to things the writer could have found in ninety seconds.

grammar.title: Building a three-tense leisure text
grammar.overview: The structure carries the marks: past experience, present habit, future plan, each signalled by its own time phrase and its own verb form.

rules.heading: Signal each tense with a time phrase
rules.formula: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ + past · الآنَ + present · فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ + future
rules.explanation: The time phrase tells the reader which tense to expect, and the verb must then match it.

rules.heading: Contrast with أَمَّا … فَـ
rules.explanation: This pair introduces a contrasting topic. The فَـ is obligatory on the second part.

rules.heading: Opinion with أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ
rules.explanation: أَنَّ makes the following noun accusative, unlike أَنْ which takes a subjunctive verb.

rules.heading: Intention with أَنْوِي أَنْ
rules.explanation: أَنْ takes the subjunctive, so the final ḍamma becomes a fatḥa.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate past-tense opening.
quiz.feedback: A childhood time phrase requires the past tense.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate contrast.
quiz.feedback: أَمَّا requires فَـ on the second part, and الآنَ requires the present.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate future plan.
quiz.feedback: سَـ attaches to a present verb.

quiz.prompt: Complete: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ ___ مُفِيدَةٌ.
quiz.feedback: أَنَّ makes the following noun accusative.

quiz.feedback: أَنْ takes the subjunctive, ending in a fatḥa.

quiz.prompt: Which sentence shows the widest tense range?
options: لَعِبْتُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ، وَأُمَارِسُ الآنَ السِّبَاحَةَ، وَسَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ.
لَعِبْتُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ وَلَعِبْتُ كَثِيرًا وَلَعِبْتُ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي.
أُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ وَأُمَارِسُ اليُوغَا وَأُمَارِسُ الجَرْيَ.
quiz.feedback: Range is rewarded for moving between tenses, not for repeating one.

quiz.prompt: Choose the accurate conclusion.
options: وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الهِوَايَاتِ مُهِمَّةٌ لِلصِّحَّةِ.
وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الهِوَايَاتُ مُهِمَّةٌ لِلصِّحَّةِ.
وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنْ الهِوَايَاتِ مُهِمَّةٌ.
quiz.feedback: أَنَّ takes an accusative subject; الهِوَايَاتِ is a sound feminine plural, whose accusative ends in kasra.

quiz.prompt: Which check belongs to the Accuracy criterion?
options: Every past verb carries the right suffix.
quiz.feedback: Accuracy is about correct forms; word count and content belong to the other criteria.

grammar.common_error: Writing the whole response in the present tense is the most common way to lose Range and Accuracy marks at once. If your text describes something that already happened, the verbs must be past.
grammar.challenge: Write three consecutive sentences that use past, present and future in that order, each signalled by its own time phrase.

listening.title: Listening: a student explains her plan for the writing task
listening.script: قَبْلَ أَنْ أَكْتُبَ، رَسَمْتُ خُطَّةً بَسِيطَةً. فِي الفِقْرَةِ الأُولَى كَتَبْتُ عَنِ المَاضِي: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ لَعِبْتُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ، وَكَانَ أَبِي يُشَجِّعُنِي كُلَّ أُسْبُوعٍ. وَفِي الفِقْرَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ كَتَبْتُ عَنِ الحَاضِرِ: أَمَّا الآنَ فَأُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ. وَفِي الفِقْرَةِ الثَّالِثَةِ كَتَبْتُ عَنِ المُسْتَقْبَلِ: سَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ، وَأَنْوِي أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ رِيَاضَةً جَدِيدَةً. وَفِي الخِتَامِ أَضَفْتُ رَأْيِي: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الرِّيَاضَةَ مُفِيدَةٌ لِلصِّحَّةِ. ثُمَّ عَدَدْتُ الكَلِمَاتِ وَرَاجَعْتُ كُلَّ لَاحِقَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What did she do before writing?
questions.feedback: قَبْلَ أَنْ أَكْتُبَ، رَسَمْتُ خُطَّةً بَسِيطَةً.

questions.prompt: What is in the first paragraph?
questions.feedback: فِي الفِقْرَةِ الأُولَى كَتَبْتُ عَنِ المَاضِي.

questions.prompt: What does she do now?
questions.feedback: أَمَّا الآنَ فَأُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.feedback: ثُمَّ عَدَدْتُ الكَلِمَاتِ وَرَاجَعْتُ كُلَّ لَاحِقَةٍ.

reading.title: Reading: a model leisure text
reading.text: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ فِي الشَّارِعِ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ. وَفِي العَامِ المَاضِي اشْتَرَكْتُ فِي نَادٍ صَغِيرٍ، وَتَدَرَّبْتُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ. فَجْأَةً أُصِبْتُ فِي رُكْبَتِي، وَلِلْأَسَفِ تَوَقَّفْتُ شَهْرَيْنِ. وَلٰكِنْ لِحُسْنِ الحَظِّ عُدْتُ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَقْوَى. أَمَّا الآنَ فَأُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَأَسْتَمْتِعُ بِهَا أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الجَرْيِ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ مَدْرَسِيَّةٍ، وَأَنْوِي أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ العَزْفَ عَلَى العُودِ أَيْضًا. وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ وَقْتَ الفَرَاغِ مُهِمٌّ لِلصِّحَّةِ وَلِلسَّعَادَةِ مَعًا.

questions.prompt: What did the writer do in childhood?
questions.feedback: كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ فِي الشَّارِعِ.

questions.prompt: What happened last year?
options: Joined a small club and trained three times a week
questions.feedback: اشْتَرَكْتُ فِي نَادٍ صَغِيرٍ، وَتَدَرَّبْتُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer stop for two months?
questions.feedback: فَجْأَةً أُصِبْتُ فِي رُكْبَتِي، وَلِلْأَسَفِ تَوَقَّفْتُ شَهْرَيْنِ.

questions.prompt: What does the writer do now?
questions.feedback: أَمَّا الآنَ فَأُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.prompt: What is the closing opinion?
options: Free time matters for health and happiness
Sport is only for the young
questions.feedback: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ وَقْتَ الفَرَاغِ مُهِمٌّ لِلصِّحَّةِ وَلِلسَّعَادَةِ مَعًا.

speaking.context: Speaking: talk your plan through before you write
prompts: مَاذَا سَتَكْتُبُ فِي الفِقْرَةِ الأُولَى عَنِ المَاضِي؟
كَيْفَ سَتَنْتَقِلُ مِنَ المَاضِي إِلَى الحَاضِرِ؟
مَا خُطَّتُكَ لِلْمُسْتَقْبَلِ؟ وَمَا رَأْيُكَ فِي الخِتَامِ؟
model: سَأَكْتُبُ عَنِ المَاضِي: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ لَعِبْتُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ، وَكَانَ أَبِي يُشَجِّعُنِي.
أَسْتَعْمِلُ أَمَّا الآنَ فَـ، ثُمَّ أَذْكُرُ خُطَّتِي بِـ سَوْفَ، وَأَخْتِمُ بِرَأْيِي.

writing.prompt: Write 130 to 140 words on وَقْتُ فَرَاغِي — المَاضِي وَالحَاضِرُ وَالمُسْتَقْبَلُ. Narrate a past experience, describe your present habit, state a future plan and close with an opinion.
checklist: At least six past verbs, each with the correct suffix.
At least two future verbs with سَـ or سَوْفَ.
One narrative connector and one كَانَ description.
A closing opinion using أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ with an accusative noun.
writing.model: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي، وَكَانَ أَبِي يُشَجِّعُنِي دَائِمًا. وَفِي العَامِ المَاضِي اشْتَرَكْتُ فِي نَادٍ قَرِيبٍ، وَتَدَرَّبْتُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ. فَجْأَةً أُصِبْتُ فِي رُكْبَتِي، وَلِلْأَسَفِ تَوَقَّفْتُ شَهْرَيْنِ، وَلٰكِنْ لِحُسْنِ الحَظِّ عُدْتُ أَقْوَى. أَمَّا الآنَ فَأُمَارِسُ السِّبَاحَةَ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَأَسْتَمْتِعُ بِهَا كَثِيرًا لِأَنَّهَا تُرِيحُنِي بَعْدَ الدِّرَاسَةِ. وَأُفَضِّلُ الرِّيَاضَةَ الجَمَاعِيَّةَ عَلَى الفَرْدِيَّةِ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ مَدْرَسِيَّةٍ، وَسَوْفَ أَتَعَلَّمُ العَزْفَ عَلَى العُودِ أَيْضًا. وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ وَقْتَ الفَرَاغِ مُهِمٌّ لِلصِّحَّةِ وَلِلسَّعَادَةِ مَعًا.

differentiation.core: Use the three-paragraph frame and write one section per tense with the given time phrases.
differentiation.develop: Link the sections with أَمَّا … فَـ and add a narrative connector to the past section.
differentiation.stretch: Add a كَانَ habit, a contrast with مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى and a justified closing opinion within the word limit.

final.feedback: أَمَّا needs فَـ, and الآنَ needs the present tense.
أَنَّ makes the following noun accusative.
أَنْ takes the subjunctive.

final.prompt: Choose the response with the strongest Range.
options: لَعِبْتُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ، وَأُمَارِسُ الآنَ السِّبَاحَةَ، وَسَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ.
لَعِبْتُ وَلَعِبْتُ وَلَعِبْتُ كَثِيرًا فِي الطُّفُولَةِ.
final.feedback: Range rewards accurate movement between tenses.

mission.title: Writing Mission — Tense Range and Accuracy
mission.intro: Each round is a decision you will make while drafting. Check the time phrase, the ending and the criterion.

rounds.prompt: Tense: complete — فِي الطُّفُولَةِ ___ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ.
rounds.feedback: A childhood time phrase requires the past.

rounds.prompt: Tense: complete — فِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ ___ فِي بُطُولَةٍ.
rounds.feedback: A future time phrase requires سَـ with a present verb.

rounds.prompt: Cohesion: which pair is complete?
rounds.feedback: أَمَّا is always answered by فَـ.

rounds.prompt: Case: complete — أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ ___ مُفِيدَةٌ.
rounds.feedback: أَنَّ takes an accusative subject.

rounds.prompt: Mood: complete — أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ ___ تُونُسَ.
rounds.feedback: أَنْ requires the subjunctive.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “in conclusion”?
rounds.feedback: وَفِي الخِتَامِ closes the response.

rounds.prompt: Collocation: complete — أُمَارِسُ ___ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.
rounds.feedback: يُمَارِسُ takes a direct accusative object.

rounds.prompt: Habit: which sentence describes a past habit?
rounds.feedback: كَانَ plus a present verb expresses a repeated past action.

rounds.prompt: Criterion: which check belongs to Accuracy?
options: The response covers four content points.
rounds.feedback: Accuracy is about correct forms.

rounds.prompt: Criterion: which check belongs to Range?
options: The response uses three different tenses.
The response answers the question asked.
rounds.feedback: Range rewards variety of structure and tense.

rounds.prompt: Connector: which marks a sudden setback?
rounds.feedback: فَجْأَةً marks the turn in a narrative.

rounds.prompt: Agreement: complete — تَجْرِبَةٌ ___ لَا تُنْسَى.
rounds.feedback: تَجْرِبَة is feminine and nominative here.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “I intend to”?
rounds.feedback: أَنْوِي أَنْ states an intention.

rounds.prompt: Transfer: which closing is the strongest?
options: وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ وَقْتَ الفَرَاغِ مُهِمٌّ لِلصِّحَّةِ.
وَفِي الخِتَامِ، أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ وَقْتُ الفَرَاغِ مُهِمٌّ.
وَفِي الخِتَامِ، وَقْتَ الفَرَاغِ مُهِمٌّ لِأَنَّ.
rounds.feedback: The strongest closing keeps the noun after أَنَّ accusative and completes the thought.

builders.target: Build a three-tense sequence from a past clause, a present clause and a future clause.
groups: فِي العَامِ المَاضِي اشْتَرَكْتُ فِي نَادٍ
فِي الصَّيْفِ المَاضِي سَافَرْتُ إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ

live_builder.target: Build a three-tense sequence from a past clause, a present clause and a future clause.
groups: فِي العَامِ المَاضِي اشْتَرَكْتُ فِي نَادٍ
فِي الصَّيْفِ المَاضِي سَافَرْتُ إِلَى الشَّاطِئِ
live_builder.feedback: Each past, present and future clause is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations build a valid three-tense sequence.

builder_tasks.title: Fix the tense after the time phrase
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the verb so it matches the childhood time phrase.
builder_tasks.feedback: The past time phrase requires the أَنَا past form لَعِبْتُ.

builder_tasks.title: Restore the فَـ after أَمَّا
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the contrast so it is grammatically complete.
builder_tasks.feedback: أَمَّا must be answered by فَـ.

builder_tasks.title: Correct the case after أَنَّ
builder_tasks.instruction: Repair the noun that follows أَنَّ.
builder_tasks.feedback: The noun after أَنَّ is accusative; the predicate stays nominative.

lessons.title: Listening — Sport, Leisure and Past Events
lessons.summary: Hear the difference between past, present and future in connected Arabic, and use tense prediction to answer Paper 1 question types.
objectives: Distinguish past, present and future verbs in connected speech.
Hear the past suffixes ـتُ، ـتَ، ـتِ، ـَتْ، ـنَا، ـُوا accurately.
Predict the tense a question is asking about before the text begins.
Reject a distractor that uses the right vocabulary in the wrong tense.
success: I identify the tense of a verb from its ending, not from the topic.
I annotate each question with the tense it targets before I read the script.
I notice when a distractor changes only the tense.
I use the time expression in the text as confirmation.

teach.title: The ending carries the tense, not the topic
teach.text: تَدَرَّبَ and يَتَدَرَّبُ describe the same activity in different times. In fast speech the difference is one prefix and one ending, so train your ear on those, not on the vocabulary around them.

teach.title: Annotate the tense before you listen
teach.text: Read each question and write P, N or F beside it for past, now or future. When the text plays, you are then listening for a specific verb form rather than for the topic in general.

grammar.title: Hearing tense in connected speech
grammar.overview: Three things separate the tenses in speech: the prefix, the suffix and the time expression. Any one of them can decide an answer, and the distractors usually change only the tense.

rules.heading: Past is marked by a suffix
rules.explanation: There is no prefix. The information sits at the end of the word, so listen through to the final syllable.

rules.heading: Present is marked by a prefix
rules.explanation: The person is signalled at the start of the word. A present verb with عَادَةً or كُلَّ يَوْمٍ describes a habit.

rules.heading: Future adds سَـ or سَوْفَ
rules.explanation: The future is the present with a marker in front. In fast speech the سَـ is short, so listen for it at the very start.

rules.heading: Tense-only distractors
rules.explanation: A common wrong option repeats the words of the text but changes the time. Check the verb form before choosing.

quiz.prompt: Which verb is past?
quiz.feedback: The suffix ـْتُ with no prefix marks the past.

quiz.prompt: Which verb is future?
quiz.feedback: سَـ before a present verb marks the future.

quiz.prompt: You hear عَادَةً. Which tense should you expect?
quiz.feedback: عَادَةً introduces a habit, so the verb will be present.

quiz.prompt: You hear الأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ. Which tense should you expect?
quiz.feedback: A future time phrase requires سَـ or سَوْفَ.

quiz.prompt: The text says فَازَ بِالبُطُولَةِ. Which option matches?
quiz.feedback: فَازَ is past, so only the completed action matches.

quiz.prompt: The text says كَانَ يَتَدَرَّبُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ. What does it mean?
options: He used to train every day.
quiz.feedback: كَانَ plus a present verb describes a past habit.

quiz.prompt: Which ending tells you the speaker is talking about herself?
quiz.feedback: ـْتُ is the أَنَا suffix.

quiz.prompt: Which is the safest first step before the audio starts?
options: Mark each question with the tense it targets.
quiz.feedback: Predicting the tense tells you exactly which verb form to listen for.

grammar.common_error: Choosing an option because it repeats words you heard. The distractor usually keeps the vocabulary and changes only the tense, so decide from the verb form.
grammar.challenge: Write the past, present and future of one verb, then say aloud which part of the word changes each time.

builders.target: Build accurate three-tense summaries from a past clause, a present habit and a future plan.
groups: فِي العَامِ المَاضِي شَارَكَ فِي بُطُولَةٍ
فِي الطُّفُولَةِ كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ اليَدِ
builders.feedback: Each past, present and future clause is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations build a valid summary.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: No prefix, and the tense information is at the end.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: A prefix plus عَادَةً signals a present habit.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: The سَـ is short but decisive.

mistakes.why: A verb with no prefix and a final fatḥa is past.
سَـ marks the future.

mistakes.wrong: Hearing كَانَ يَلْعَبُ and answering “he plays”.
mistakes.right: كَانَ يَلْعَبُ means “he used to play”.
mistakes.why: كَانَ places the habit in the past.

listening.title: Listening: an athlete across three tenses
listening.script: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ اليَدِ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ، وَكَانَ مُدَرِّبِي يُشَجِّعُنِي كَثِيرًا. وَفِي العَامِ المَاضِي شَارَكْتُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ وَفُزْتُ بِمِيدَالِيَةٍ فِضِّيَّةٍ. أَمَّا الآنَ فَأَتَدَرَّبُ عَادَةً أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَأُفَضِّلُ التَّدْرِيبَ الصَّبَاحِيَّ. وَفِي رَأْيِي الرِّيَاضَةُ تُعَلِّمُ الصَّبْرَ وَالعَمَلَ الجَمَاعِيَّ. وَالأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ سَأُشَارِكُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ وَدِّيَّةٍ، وَسَوْفَ أُحَاوِلُ أَنْ أُحَسِّنَ نَتِيجَتِي. وَبَعْدَ سَنَوَاتٍ أَنْوِي أَنْ أُدَرِّبَ الأَطْفَالَ.

questions.prompt: What did the speaker do in childhood?
options: Used to play handball at school
questions.feedback: كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ اليَدِ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ — كَانَ plus a present verb.

questions.prompt: What happened last year?
questions.feedback: فُزْتُ بِمِيدَالِيَةٍ فِضِّيَّةٍ.

questions.prompt: How often does the speaker train now?
questions.feedback: أَتَدَرَّبُ عَادَةً أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ.

questions.prompt: What will happen next week?
questions.feedback: الأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ سَأُشَارِكُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ وَدِّيَّةٍ.

questions.prompt: What is the long-term intention?
questions.feedback: أَنْوِي أَنْ أُدَرِّبَ الأَطْفَالَ.

reading.title: Reading: the transcript, annotated for tense
reading.text: اِقْرَأِ النَّصَّ وَحَدِّدْ زَمَنَ كُلِّ فِعْلٍ. فِي الصَّيْفِ المَاضِي حَضَرْنَا مِهْرَجَانًا رِيَاضِيًّا فِي المَدِينَةِ. شَارَكَ فِيهِ لَاعِبُونَ مِنْ مَدَارِسَ كَثِيرَةٍ، وَفَازَ فَرِيقُنَا بِالمَرْكَزِ الثَّانِي. وَكَانَ الجُمْهُورُ يُشَجِّعُ بِحَمَاسٍ طَوَالَ اليَوْمِ. أَمَّا الآنَ فَنَتَدَرَّبُ عَادَةً مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ اسْتِعْدَادًا لِلْمَوْسِمِ الجَدِيدِ. وَفِي الشَّهْرِ القَادِمِ سَوْفَ نُشَارِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ أُخْرَى، وَنَتَمَنَّى أَنْ نَفُوزَ بِالمَرْكَزِ الأَوَّلِ هٰذِهِ المَرَّةَ.

questions.prompt: Which tense is حَضَرْنَا?
questions.feedback: The ـنَا suffix with no prefix marks the past.

questions.prompt: What position did the team take?
questions.feedback: فَازَ فَرِيقُنَا بِالمَرْكَزِ الثَّانِي.

questions.prompt: What does كَانَ الجُمْهُورُ يُشَجِّعُ mean?
questions.feedback: كَانَ plus a present verb describes an ongoing past action.

questions.prompt: Which tense is نَتَدَرَّبُ عَادَةً?
questions.feedback: A prefix plus عَادَةً marks a present habit.

questions.prompt: What is planned for next month?
questions.feedback: فِي الشَّهْرِ القَادِمِ سَوْفَ نُشَارِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ أُخْرَى.

prompts: مَاذَا فَعَلَ المُتَحَدِّثُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ؟ وَمَاذَا فَعَلَ فِي العَامِ المَاضِي؟
مَاذَا يَفْعَلُ الآنَ عَادَةً؟
مَا خُطَطُهُ لِلْمُسْتَقْبَلِ؟ اِسْتَعْمِلْ سَـ أَوْ سَوْفَ.
model: مَاذَا فَعَلَ المُتَحَدِّثُ فِي العَامِ المَاضِي؟
شَارَكَ فِي بُطُولَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ وَفَازَ بِمِيدَالِيَةٍ فِضِّيَّةٍ.
يَتَدَرَّبُ عَادَةً أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَالأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ سَيُشَارِكُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ.

writing.prompt: Write about seventy words summarising the listening text. Report what the speaker did in the past, what they do now and what they will do, keeping each verb in the tense the text used.
checklist: At least three past verbs with accurate suffixes.
At least two present verbs describing a habit.
At least one future verb with سَـ or سَوْفَ.
One كَانَ plus present construction for a past habit.
writing.model: فِي الطُّفُولَةِ كَانَ المُتَحَدِّثُ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ اليَدِ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ، وَكَانَ مُدَرِّبُهُ يُشَجِّعُهُ كَثِيرًا. وَفِي العَامِ المَاضِي شَارَكَ فِي بُطُولَةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ وَفَازَ بِمِيدَالِيَةٍ فِضِّيَّةٍ. أَمَّا الآنَ فَيَتَدَرَّبُ عَادَةً أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ، وَيُفَضِّلُ التَّدْرِيبَ الصَّبَاحِيَّ. وَيَرَى أَنَّ الرِّيَاضَةَ تُعَلِّمُ الصَّبْرَ. وَالأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ سَيُشَارِكُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ وَدِّيَّةٍ، وَسَوْفَ يُحَاوِلُ أَنْ يُحَسِّنَ نَتِيجَتَهُ.

rounds.prompt: Which is future?

rounds.feedback: عَادَةً introduces a present habit.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “took part in”?
rounds.feedback: شَارَكَ فِي means took part in.

rounds.prompt: Which suffix marks أَنْتِ?
rounds.feedback: The kasra ending addresses one female.

rounds.prompt: Which is the نَحْنُ past of حَضَرَ?
rounds.feedback: نَحْنُ takes ـنَا.

rounds.prompt: The text says فَازَ. Which option matches?
rounds.feedback: فَازَ is a completed past action.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “retired from sport”?

rounds.feedback: القَادِم points forward.

rounds.prompt: Which is the هُمْ past of شَارَكَ?

شَارَكَ العَامَ المَاضِيَ، وَشَارَكَ الآنَ، وَشَارَكَ غَدًا.

builders.target: Build accurate three-tense summaries from a past clause, a present habit and a future plan.

فِي الطُّفُولَةِ كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ اليَدِ

live_builder.feedback: Each past, present and future clause is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations build a valid summary.

builder_tasks.title: Correct the tense you heard
builder_tasks.instruction: The text said the action is finished. Repair the verb.
builder_tasks.feedback: A past time phrase requires a past verb.

builder_tasks.title: Turn the action into a past habit
builder_tasks.instruction: Rewrite so the sentence describes what he used to do.
options: كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ اليَدِ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ.
كَانَ لَعِبَ كُرَةَ اليَدِ فِي المَدْرَسَةِ.

الأُسْبُوعَ القَادِمَ كَانَ يُشَارِكُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ.
builder_tasks.feedback: A future marker requires سَـ with a present verb.

lessons.title: D5 Consolidation — Past Tense Mastery and Speaking Preparation
lessons.arabic: تَرْسِيخُ الوَحْدَةِ — إِتْقَانُ الفِعْلِ المَاضِي وَإِعْدَادُ التَّحَدُّثِ
lessons.summary: Bring the whole D5 system together and rehearse producing accurate past tense in spontaneous speech before the unit assessment.
objectives: Produce accurate past-tense suffixes under conversational pressure.
Avoid the common strategy of substituting the present tense for the past.
Move between past, present and future within a single spoken answer.
Prepare independently for the D5 assessment across all four skills.
success: I use the past tense when the question asks about the past, rather than switching to the present.
I keep the suffix accurate on at least eight out of ten spontaneous past verbs.
I answer with a reason and a detail, not a single word.
I can name my own weakest verb family and practise it.

teach.title: The avoidance trap
teach.text: Under pressure many candidates answer a past question in the present, because the present is easier to form. Examiners notice this immediately. If the question contains a past verb or a past time phrase, your answer must contain one too.

teach.title: Buy time in Arabic, not in silence
teach.text: دَعْنِي أُفَكِّرُ and سُؤَالٌ جَيِّدٌ give you a second to assemble the verb while still speaking Arabic. A short filler in the target language costs nothing; a long silence costs fluency marks.

grammar.title: Past-tense accuracy under pressure
grammar.overview: This lesson revisits the whole D5 system as a checklist you can apply while speaking: choose the person, choose the stem, attach the suffix, then add a reason.

rules.heading: Answer in the tense of the question
rules.explanation: If the examiner uses a past verb or a past time phrase, mirror it. Answering in the present is the most common avoidance pattern.
examples: مَاذَا فَعَلْتَ أَمْسِ؟ — لَعِبْتُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ

rules.heading: Check the stem before the suffix
rules.explanation: قَالَ becomes قُلْـ, مَشَى becomes مَشَيْـ, and only then does the suffix go on.

rules.heading: Extend every answer
rules.explanation: A bare verb scores little. Add لِأَنَّ, a frequency phrase or a connector to turn an answer into a response.
examples: تَدَرَّبْتُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ثُمَّ شَارَكْتُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ

rules.heading: Move between tenses deliberately
rules.explanation: A strong topic answer narrates, then describes the habit now, then states a plan.
examples: بَدَأْتُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ، وَأُمَارِسُهَا الآنَ، وَسَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ

quiz.prompt: The examiner asks: كَيْفَ بَدَأْتَ هٰذِهِ الهِوَايَةَ؟ Which answer is appropriate?
quiz.feedback: A past question requires a past answer with the correct أَنَا suffix.

quiz.prompt: The examiner asks: مَاذَا فَعَلْتِ أَمْسِ؟ Which answer is appropriate for a female candidate?
quiz.feedback: Speaking about yourself uses ـْتُ regardless of gender; ـْتِ is for addressing a female.

quiz.prompt: Which answer avoids the past tense and should be repaired?
quiz.feedback: Using the present after أَمْسِ is the avoidance pattern examiners look for.

quiz.prompt: Which phrase buys thinking time in Arabic?
quiz.feedback: A short Arabic filler keeps you speaking the target language.

quiz.prompt: Which is the strongest extended answer?
options: تَدَرَّبْتُ مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ لِأَنَّنِي أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُحَسِّنَ نَتِيجَتِي.
quiz.feedback: The strongest answer adds a frequency phrase and a reason.

quiz.prompt: Which stem is correct before the suffix?
quiz.feedback: زَارَ shortens to زُرْـ before a consonant suffix.

quiz.prompt: Which repair phrase corrects a slip mid-sentence?
quiz.feedback: عَفْوًا، أَقْصِدُ signals a self-correction.

quiz.prompt: Which answer shows deliberate tense variety?
options: بَدَأْتُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ، وَأُمَارِسُهَا الآنَ، وَسَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ.
quiz.feedback: Moving through three tenses is what raises the Quality of Language mark.

grammar.common_error: Substituting the present for the past when a question is about a past event. It is the single most visible weakness in D5 speaking, and it is entirely avoidable once you listen for the tense of the question.
grammar.challenge: Answer three past questions aloud in one minute, each with a reason, and count how many suffixes you got right.

builders.target: Build complete spoken answers from a past clause, a reason and a forward-looking close.
builders.feedback: Each past clause, reason and forward-looking close is accurate on its own, so any three different combinations make a complete answer.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: The past question is mirrored by a past answer.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: A short Arabic filler protects your fluency mark.

patterns.label: What to notice
patterns.tip: Action plus reason turns an answer into a response.

mistakes.why: Answering a past question in the present is the avoidance pattern.
The hollow stem must shorten before the suffix.

mistakes.right: نَعَمْ، لَعِبْتُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ.
mistakes.why: A one-word answer cannot show range or accuracy.

listening.title: Listening: a candidate answering under pressure
listening.script: المُمْتَحِنُ: كَيْفَ بَدَأْتَ هٰذِهِ الهِوَايَةَ؟ الطَّالِبُ: سُؤَالٌ جَيِّدٌ. بَدَأْتُ فِي الطُّفُولَةِ، لِأَنَّ أَخِي كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ. المُمْتَحِنُ: وَمَاذَا فَعَلْتَ الأُسْبُوعَ المَاضِيَ؟ الطَّالِبُ: دَعْنِي أُفَكِّرُ. تَدَرَّبْتُ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ شَارَكْتُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ وَدِّيَّةٍ، وَلِلْأَسَفِ خَسِرْنَا. عَفْوًا، أَقْصِدُ تَعَادَلْنَا. المُمْتَحِنُ: وَمَا خُطَطُكَ؟ الطَّالِبُ: فِي الحَقِيقَةِ، سَأَشْتَرِكُ فِي بُطُولَةٍ مَدْرَسِيَّةٍ، وَأَنْوِي أَنْ أَتَدَرَّبَ أَكْثَرَ.

questions.prompt: How does the student begin his first reply?
questions.feedback: سُؤَالٌ جَيِّدٌ buys a moment while staying in Arabic.

questions.prompt: Why did the student start the hobby?
options: Because his brother used to play
Because he saw it on television
questions.feedback: لِأَنَّ أَخِي كَانَ يَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ.

questions.prompt: What did he do last week?
options: Trained twice and played a friendly
questions.feedback: تَدَرَّبْتُ مَرَّتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ شَارَكْتُ فِي مُبَارَاةٍ وَدِّيَّةٍ.

questions.prompt: What does عَفْوًا، أَقْصِدُ signal?
questions.feedback: It introduces a repair: he corrects خَسِرْنَا to تَعَادَلْنَا.

questions.prompt: Which tense does he use for his plans?
options: Future with سَـ and أَنْوِي أَنْ
questions.feedback: سَأَشْتَرِكُ … وَأَنْوِي أَنْ أَتَدَرَّبَ.

reading.title: Reading: a candidate's self-review before the assessment
reading.text: قَبْلَ التَّقْيِيمِ رَاجَعْتُ نُقَاطَ ضَعْفِي بِصَرَاحَةٍ. فِي البِدَايَةِ كُنْتُ أَسْتَعْمِلُ المُضَارِعَ عِنْدَمَا يَسْأَلُنِي المُعَلِّمُ عَنِ المَاضِي، وَهٰذَا خَطَأٌ شَائِعٌ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْتُ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ أَفْعَالٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَرَكَّزْتُ عَلَى الأَفْعَالِ الشَّاذَّةِ مِثْلَ قَالَ وَزَارَ وَمَشَى. وَفِي الحَقِيقَةِ تَحَسَّنَتْ دِقَّتِي مِنْ سِتَّةٍ إِلَى تِسْعَةٍ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ. أَمَّا الآنَ فَأَسْتَعْمِلُ عِبَارَاتٍ قَصِيرَةً مِثْلَ دَعْنِي أُفَكِّرُ بَدَلَ الصَّمْتِ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأُرَكِّزُ عَلَى إِضَافَةِ سَبَبٍ فِي كُلِّ إِجَابَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What was the writer's original weakness?
options: Using the present when asked about the past
questions.feedback: كُنْتُ أَسْتَعْمِلُ المُضَارِعَ عِنْدَمَا يَسْأَلُنِي المُعَلِّمُ عَنِ المَاضِي.

questions.prompt: How did the writer practise?
questions.feedback: تَدَرَّبْتُ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ أَفْعَالٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.

questions.prompt: How did accuracy change?
options: From six to nine out of ten
questions.feedback: تَحَسَّنَتْ دِقَّتِي مِنْ سِتَّةٍ إِلَى تِسْعَةٍ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ.

questions.prompt: What replaces silence now?
questions.feedback: أَسْتَعْمِلُ عِبَارَاتٍ قَصِيرَةً مِثْلَ دَعْنِي أُفَكِّرُ بَدَلَ الصَّمْتِ.

questions.prompt: What is the future focus?
options: Adding a reason to every answer
questions.feedback: سَأُرَكِّزُ عَلَى إِضَافَةِ سَبَبٍ فِي كُلِّ إِجَابَةٍ.

writing.model: فِي البِدَايَةِ كُنْتُ أَسْتَعْمِلُ المُضَارِعَ عِنْدَمَا يَسْأَلُنِي المُعَلِّمُ عَنِ المَاضِي، وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ خَطَأً شَائِعًا. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْتُ عَلَى عَشَرَةِ أَفْعَالٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَرَكَّزْتُ عَلَى الأَفْعَالِ الشَّاذَّةِ مِثْلَ قَالَ وَزَارَ وَمَشَى. وَلِحُسْنِ الحَظِّ تَحَسَّنَتْ دِقَّتِي كَثِيرًا. أَمَّا الآنَ فَأَسْتَعْمِلُ عِبَارَاتٍ قَصِيرَةً بَدَلَ الصَّمْتِ، وَأُضِيفُ سَبَبًا فِي كُلِّ إِجَابَةٍ. وَفِي المُسْتَقْبَلِ سَأُرَكِّزُ عَلَى تَنَوُّعِ الأَزْمِنَةِ، وَأَنْوِي أَنْ أَتَدَرَّبَ عَلَى التَّحَدُّثِ يَوْمِيًّا.

rounds.prompt: Verb form: which is the أَنَا past of شَارَكَ?

rounds.prompt: Stem: which is correct?

rounds.prompt: Which phrase buys time in Arabic?
rounds.feedback: It keeps you speaking Arabic while you assemble the verb.

rounds.prompt: Extension: which adds most to a bare answer?

rounds.prompt: Which answer avoids the past and needs repair?

rounds.prompt: Verb form: which is the نَحْنُ past of تَعَادَلَ?
rounds.feedback: نَحْنُ takes ـنَا.

rounds.prompt: Vocabulary: which means “in fact”?

rounds.prompt: Past habit: which is accurate?

rounds.prompt: Preposition: complete — شَارَكْتُ ___ بُطُولَةٍ.

rounds.prompt: Collocation: complete — أَعْزِفُ ___ العُودِ.
